source.label: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Our Workforce
source.quote: At the end of fiscal 2025, we employed approximately 472,400 associates, of whom approximately 53,400 were salaried, with the remainder compensated on an hourly basis.

payroll.label: Annual total compensation of our median-paid associate, other than our CEO (Fiscal 2025)

source.label: 2026 proxy statement, CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The annual total compensation of our median-paid associate, other than our CEO, was $37,881 . Our median-paid associate for Fiscal 2025 was an hourly employee in the U.S.

notes: Employees: approximate head count at the end of fiscal 2025 (February 1, 2026), full- and part-time; 422,500 were in the U.S. Payroll: the Fiscal 2025 10-K discloses no total staff cost (it mentions only "payroll and related costs" in the SG&A discussion, with no amount), so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for Fiscal 2025 is used (ratio 427 to 1). The median-paid associate was identified as of December 31, 2025 and is an hourly U.S. employee; associates in Mexico (about 17,800) and several small countries were excluded under the de minimis exception.
